systems.system: The National File / Biometric National Identity Card
systems.country_label: The National File/Biometric National Identity Card
systems.tiers: national foundational ID as the World Bank's Annex D lists it; no digital ID system; 56 per cent of adults reported owning the ID in the Findex survey fielded 3 July to 13 August 2024 (58 per cent of men, 53 per cent of women)

note: A global dataset on identity-document ownership. For the Republic of the Congo it gives adult ID coverage and names the foundational identity credential; it says nothing of civil registration offices or how births and deaths are recorded there.
